items.title: The five editing passes I run before anyone else reads the page
items.description:
Most people edit by rereading. Rereading catches typos. It does not catch why the page isn't working.

I edit prose for other people, in English and French. I only ever run five passes, one problem each, in this order. I don't mix them, because each pass is blind to the others.
